questions.q: In a concerto grosso, which group is called the ripieno?
questions.why: The ripieno is the larger group; the concertino is the small solo group.

questions.q: Which feature is most typical of Baroque music?
options: Sonata form with two contrasting subjects
questions.why: Continuo (bass line plus harpsichord or organ chords) is the Baroque giveaway.

questions.q: In the recapitulation of a sonata form movement in a major key, the second subject is in...
questions.why: It moves from the dominant (exposition) back to the tonic (recapitulation).

questions.q: Describe how Vivaldi depicts a storm in Spring (first movement). [2]
questions.model: The music moves to the minor and the violins play fast tremolo and rushing scales to suggest thunder and lightning.
points: minor key / dark mood or tremolo
fast scales / rushing passages (thunder and lightning)
